summary: Make repository-level handoff validation preserve immutable historical evidence while checking the current SHA only for the latest handoff that mentions each artifact path.
decisions: Keep direct validate_handoff_payload calls strict against the current target repository.
At directory validation time, check current content only for the chronologically latest handoff per artifact path, regardless of run_id.
Continue schema and digest-format validation for superseded handoff records so historical evidence remains auditable.

gate_results.evidence: Every historical artifact digest is currently compared to the mutable worktree, so a legitimate later handoff makes an earlier record fail validation.

risks: Selecting latest records only by run_id would still fail when a later run updates the same artifact.
Ties must be deterministic and separate artifact paths must retain independent latest-record checks.
next_action: Ontology Compiler updates only agent_team.py and its tests, covers same-run and cross-run supersession plus direct strict validation, then returns a schema-valid completion handoff.
